Such benefits may be available to: An eligible dependent of an A, G, or NATO nonimmigrant requesting employment authorization; An A, G, or NATO nonimmigrant requesting a change to another nonimmigrant status; A nonimmigrant in another status who has been offered a position that requires reclassification as an A, G, or NATO nonimmigrant, and any dependents in another nonimmigrant status; or An A, G
